l4_steps.name: Detect Open Crew Position Requiring Deadhead
l4_steps.input: Schedule change event, crew absence report, or pairing modification trigger
l4_steps.output: Open position flag with required report time and destination station
l4_steps.kpi: Position detected within 30 min of trigger event; 95th-percentile detection latency
l4_steps.pain_point: Late notification from operations control reduces available positioning flight windows, forcing costlier interline or charter options

l4_steps.name: Calculate Deadhead Eligibility & Rest Window
l4_steps.input: Crew member duty history, block hours, and rest timestamps from pairing record
l4_steps.output: Earliest legal report time per FAR Part 117 / EASA FTL; rest compliance flag
l4_steps.kpi: 100% FAR Part 117 compliance on all deadhead assignments; 0 regulatory violations
l4_steps.pain_point: Cumulative duty and transport time ambiguity under FAR Part 117 §117.25; manual override risk when schedulers bypass system warnings under pressure

l4_steps.name: Identify Available Positioning Flight Options
l4_steps.input: Origin station, destination station, required arrival window
l4_steps.output: Ranked list of viable positioning flights with seat availability and timing feasibility
l4_steps.kpi: ≥3 routing options identified per positioning requirement; identification completed ≤15 min
l4_steps.pain_point: Limited own-metal frequency on thin or spoke routes forces interline deadheads at significantly higher cost and approval overhead

l4_steps.name: Check Own-Airline Seat Availability
l4_steps.input: Positioning flight options list, cabin inventory snapshot
l4_steps.output: Seat availability confirmation per candidate flight
l4_steps.kpi: Own-carrier deadhead utilisation rate ≥85% of all positioning trips
l4_steps.pain_point: High load factors on peak routes (>90% LF) eliminate deadhead seat inventory; conflicts arise with revenue upgrade requests in the same booking class

l4_steps.name: Request Interline or Charter Positioning
l4_steps.input: No own-carrier availability confirmed; positioning deadline and budget ceiling
l4_steps.output: Interline booking confirmation or charter request raised with vendor
l4_steps.kpi: Interline deadhead cost ≤$500 per segment average; charter approval ≤60 min
l4_steps.pain_point: Absence of interline agreements with ultra-low-cost carriers limits competitive options; charter approvals require multi-level sign-off, slowing time-critical positioning

l4_steps.name: Book Deadhead Seat & Issue Travel Document
l4_steps.input: Confirmed flight selection, crew ID and employee number
l4_steps.output: PNR booking record, crew boarding pass, travel authorisation number
l4_steps.kpi: Booking confirmed ≥4 hours before positioning flight departure; 98% booking success rate
l4_steps.pain_point: Deadhead bookings compete with upgrade inventory management; system priority rules inconsistently applied across stations, causing silent booking failures

l4_steps.name: Notify Crew of Deadhead Assignment via App
l4_steps.input: Confirmed PNR, flight details, report time, and destination duty assignment
l4_steps.output: Push notification delivered to crew mobile app; acknowledgment receipt logged
l4_steps.kpi: Crew notification issued ≥3 hours before check-in; acknowledgment rate ≥95% within 30 min
l4_steps.pain_point: Unacknowledged assignments discovered late trigger cascading delays; crew contact reliability degrades during IROPS when app server load peaks

l4_steps.name: Coordinate Priority Boarding with Departure Gate
l4_steps.input: Crew PNR, flight gate assignment, boarding time
l4_steps.output: Priority boarding flag applied to PNR; gate agent briefed on crew presence
l4_steps.kpi: Deadhead crew boarded before door close 100% of trips; 0 involuntary offloads
l4_steps.pain_point: Gate agent awareness of deadhead priority inconsistent across stations; crew offloaded during oversale situations without crew scheduling notification

l4_steps.name: Verify Crew Check-In Within Required Window
l4_steps.input: Check-in event, seat map, boarding pass issuance status
l4_steps.output: Boarding pass issued; seat confirmed; check-in timestamp logged
l4_steps.kpi: Check-in completed ≥90 min before STD (international) or ≥60 min (domestic) — 100% compliance
l4_steps.pain_point: Self-service kiosks cannot identify crew priority status; manual override at check-in desk required but not always flagged in AMS leading to seat assignment conflicts

l4_steps.name: Monitor Positioning Flight Departure Status
l4_steps.input: STD, real-time flight status feed from OAG Flight Status API
l4_steps.output: Departure alert triggered if delay ≥30 min detected against crew arrival window
l4_steps.kpi: Delay alert generated within 5 min of ATD divergence; monitoring coverage 100% of active deadheads
l4_steps.pain_point: Real-time flight status integration latency (up to 8 min) causes late crew re-planning; ATC data feed inconsistencies during high-traffic periods create false-negative alerts

l4_steps.name: Confirm Crew Boarded on Positioning Flight
l4_steps.input: Boarding scan data from gate reader
l4_steps.kpi: On-board confirmation received ≥15 min before block-out; 100% of tracked deadheads
l4_steps.pain_point: Boarding scan data not always relayed to crew scheduling in real time; crew off-loaded for weight-and-balance or oversale without crew scheduling notification causes undetected open positions

l4_steps.name: Confirm Crew Arrival at Destination Station
l4_steps.input: Positioning flight block-in time, crew self-report via mobile app
l4_steps.output: Arrival confirmation timestamp logged in pairing record
l4_steps.kpi: Arrival confirmed within 15 min of block-in; 100% of active positioning trips
l4_steps.pain_point: Crew app connectivity issues in remote or international airports; manual phone confirmation fallback increases coordinator workload during multi-disruption IROPS events

l4_steps.name: Validate Rest Compliance Before Activating Duty
l4_steps.input: Arrival timestamp, cumulative duty history, transport time log, FAR Part 117 rule set
l4_steps.output: Go / No-Go duty eligibility decision; compliance audit record
l4_steps.kpi: 0 FAR Part 117 violations; 100% FTL compliance audit pass rate; review completed ≤10 min
l4_steps.pain_point: Ambiguity in counting deadhead transport time against rest requirements under FAR Part 117 §117.25(d); grey-area interpretations vary by base chief pilot, creating inconsistent application

l4_steps.name: Activate Crew for Assigned Duty Pairing
l4_steps.input: Go decision from compliance check; destination duty pairing details
l4_steps.output: Crew activated in system; pairing record updated; downstream operations notified
l4_steps.kpi: Crew activation completed ≥45 min before STD of first duty leg; 98% on-time activation rate
l4_steps.pain_point: Late activations (<45 min before STD) trigger minimum connect time violations requiring re-planning; system does not auto-notify gate agents of late crew activation status

l4_steps.name: Initiate Disruption Recovery for Failed Positioning
l4_steps.input: Missed or critically delayed positioning flight; unresolved open crew position
l4_steps.output: Alternative coverage plan: standby activation, crew reassignment, or re-deadhead routing
l4_steps.kpi: Alternative solution identified within 20 min of confirmed disruption; 0 flights cancelled solely due to unresolved crew positioning failure
l4_steps.pain_point: Standby crew pool depleted during IROPS; simultaneous multi-station disruptions overwhelm scheduling coordinator capacity; re-deadhead approval chains add 30–45 min delay during peak disruption windows
